cases.sourceRationale: Official SIM settings procedure requires Owner or Manager privileges.

expectedOutcome.title: Turn on protection through My Verizon
expectedOutcome.nextStep: Open Account → Account settings → Security settings. Edit SIM Protection for the intended line, turn it on, save, and complete any verification Verizon requests.
prerequisites: An Account Owner or Manager sign-in.
Access to any verification required by Verizon.

cases.sourceRationale: A legitimate intended device change must account for protection and delay.

expectedOutcome.title: Review the protection change before proceeding
expectedOutcome.nextStep: For an intended SIM or device change, edit SIM Protection in My Verizon’s Security settings. Disabling it does not permit an immediate transaction: Verizon describes a 15-minute block and possible additional delay.
prerequisites: An authorized Owner or Manager sign-in.
A deliberate, legitimate SIM or device change.
unresolved: Follow Verizon’s current confirmation and timing instructions.

unresolved: Activation prerequisites and timing remain with Verizon.
